title: Rental Contract Charges: Mileage, Fuel, Waivers and Fees (Bluegate Moving Truck Rental)
content:
**Charges section of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental rental contract terms.** The figures named below are the class figures on the rate card, the damage waiver schedule and the fuel and fee schedule.

### In force

1. **Mileage.** Mileage is charged at the class mileage rate per mile on the miles driven — the odometer reading at return less the odometer reading at pickup — less any included miles. The miles charged are never fewer than zero, and the mileage charge is rounded to the cent.
2. **Environmental fee.** The class environmental fee is posted once per contract, at return.
3. **Damage waiver fee.** When the renter takes the basic or the premium damage waiver at the counter, the class fee for that waiver is posted for each rental period.
4. **Fuel.** Fuel is read in eighths of a tank and must be refilled with the fuel the class takes. Fuel below the pickup level is charged at the class refuel charge for each eighth short; fuel above the pickup level is not credited.
5. **Additional drivers.** Each additional authorized driver adds the class additional-driver fee once per contract.
6. **Cleaning, smoking and accessories.** The cleaning fee, the smoking fee and the dolly and furniture-pad fees are posted when they apply.
7. **Rounding.** All amounts are rounded to the cent.

### Retired

8. A contract is charged the class rental fee for each rental period started, a period being the class rental period in elapsed hours from the actual pickup time; the first period is posted at pickup. — This clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for rental-day charges.

## Worked figures (hypothetical contract, Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck, no included miles)

| Item | Recorded at pickup | Recorded at return | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Odometer | 12,000 miles | 12,087 miles | 87 miles at 0.99 per mile, 86.13 |
| Fuel gauge | 6 eighths | 4 eighths | 2 eighths short at 12.00 each, 24.00 |

- Had the fuel gauge read 7 eighths at return, one eighth above the pickup level, no fuel charge would be posted and nothing would be credited for the extra eighth.
- Had the renter added two authorized drivers on this class, whose additional-driver fee is 0.00, nothing would be added for them; on a Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck the same two drivers would add 10.00 each, once per contract.

superseded_clauses: A contract is charged base_rate_usd for each rental period started, a period being rental_period_hours elapsed hours from the actual pickup time; the first period is posted at pickup.
